name: Sujala Trading & Holdings Limited
about: Sujala Trading & Holdings Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. The company engages primarily in investment in shares and securities, lending, and offering credit facilities, corporate and personal loans, private funding. It also delivers loans and advances and acts as a financial intermediary to channel financial resources for capital formation. In addition, the company acquires and trades in shares/stocks/bonds/debentures/securities issued by government, local authorities, or other securities. Further, it provides leasing and hire-purchase services. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Kolkata, India.
